prompt: Our template engine's `{% for %}` needs the usual loop helpers — `loop.index` (1-based), `loop.index0`, `loop.first`, `loop.last`, `loop.length` — plus an optional `{% else %}` branch inside the for block that renders when there is nothing to iterate. Templates get fed generators too, so don't rely on the sequence having a len(). While you're in there: right now the loop variable leaks out after `{% endfor %}` and clobbers any outer variable with the same name; loop names (including `loop`) should only exist inside the loop body. Separately, our HTML escaping ignores quotes, which breaks attribute values — `"` must become `"` and `'` must become `'` everywhere we escape.
